Update InstrumentationModule Javadoc for unconditional versioned-first ordering `instrumentation/​vertx/​vertx-web-3.0/​javaagent/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​javaagent/​instrumentation/​vertx/​web/​v3_0/​VertxWebInstrumentationModule.java:19` [Javaagent] Making the versioned-first hierarchy unconditional leaves the public `InstrumentationModule` constructor contract inaccurate: its Javadoc still says this ordering applies only under `otel.instrumentation.common.v3-preview=true` and that compatibility aliases retain precedence outside preview (`javaagent-extension-api/.../InstrumentationModule.java:46-78`). Please update that contract as part of this migration so extension authors are not given behavior that these constructors no longer implement.

Use versioned-first Java agent instrumentation names unconditionally and remove legacy and implementation-only enablement aliases. Part of #20510.

```properties
# Before
otel.instrumentation.cxf-3.2.enabled=false
# After
otel.instrumentation.jaxrs-2.0-cxf-3.2.enabled=false
```

Versioned component selectors now take precedence over role, versionless, and umbrella selectors. Shared component selectors control all of their implementations; CHANGELOG.md lists replacements and changed umbrella membership.

Removes the internal `DeprecatedInstrumentationNames` extension helper. Emitted scope names and declarative selector spelling changes are separate PRs.
metadata.title: Use versioned-first instrumentation names and remove legacy aliases
